reviews.title: Nice and large, works perfectly!
reviews.comment: I usually use an optical mouse on a desk, but lately I've been having issues with my mice (or mices if you've failed basic English) due to the surface of the desk becoming more polished due to excessive wear.  So I purchased this large mouse mat to fix the issue. 1:  It's large, very large, I actually have my large keyboard on the left side of it while the right side still has more than enough room for my mouse area. 2:  The RGB aspect is actually quite pleasant and I find the color to be quite calming.  I'm now leaving compliments on people's videos and social media instead of trolling them. 3:  The quality is rather nice, the fabric is soft but very functional. If you have a large desk and need a large mouse pad, I would give this one a go, I'm certainly very happy with it.
reviews.author: DemonView LLC

reviews.title: Soft and Looks Great With the Setup
reviews.comment: Got this for my hubby’s gaming setup and he really likes it! The mousepad is soft, feels nice quality, and the RGB lighting matches the rest of his setup vibes perfectly. It made the whole desk look more put together and aesthetic. Definitely happy with this purchase!
reviews.author: nelly

reviews.title: Bright, Huge, and Great Quality for the Price!
reviews.comment: This RGB mouse pad is massive and looks awesome on the desk. The LED lights are bright, have multiple color modes, and it even comes with the cable. It’s lightweight, grips the desk well, and covers a large area for both keyboard and mouse. Excellent quality and value — definitely worth it if you want to upgrade your setup’s look.
reviews.author: Thomas

reviews.title: Lighting is Underwhelming but Overall Great For Price
reviews.comment: As someone who spends a lot of time gaming and working on a computer, I was in the market for an RGB mouse pad to brighten up my setup. After doing some research, I came across a generic RGB mouse pad that had an amazing price compared to other RGB mouse pads on the market. I have to say, I'm pretty impressed with this mouse pad. First of all, the RGB lighting is really bright and vibrant. It adds a great touch of personality to my setup, and it's definitely an eye-catching feature. I also appreciate that the mouse pad is a decent size, which gives me plenty of room to move my mouse around. One thing that I did notice is that the surface of the mouse pad isn't as smooth as some other more expensive options. This can make it a bit more difficult to move the mouse around quickly and accurately, but it's not a deal breaker for me. Overall, I think that this generic RGB mouse pad is a great value for the price. It's half the price of some other options on the market, and it still looks great and has some decent functionality. If you're in the market for an RGB mouse pad and don't want to spend a ton of money, this is definitely a product worth considering. That being said, if you're a hardcore gamer or someone who needs the absolute best performance out of their mouse pad, you might want to invest in a more expensive option with a smoother surface.
reviews.author: Hmb2k14

reviews.title: Good for its price, could be better.
reviews.comment: Very high quality for a good price. Can game endlessly, and mice glide so easily. Not too thick, and the design is perfect for my desk. Cleans super easily, and the RGB colors are not the best, but good!
